items.question: Do I need a reservation to dine at your restaurant?
items.answer: Reservations are recommended, especially on weekends and during peak hours, to ensure your preferred table and a seamless dining experience.

items.question: What type of cuisine do you serve?
items.answer: We are a multi-cuisine restaurant: Indian favourites, continental grills, pastas, burgers and desserts, all freshly prepared by our chefs.

items.question: Do you offer vegetarian and special diet options?
items.answer: Yes. Our menu has plenty of vegetarian dishes, and our team is happy to adapt meals for vegan, gluten-free or other dietary needs.

items.question: Is there parking available at the restaurant?
items.answer: Yes, free parking is available for our guests right next to the restaurant.

items.question: Can I host a private event or party at your restaurant?
items.answer: Absolutely. We host birthdays, family get-togethers and corporate dinners. Contact us and we will plan the menu and seating with you.
